decision.summary: NO_ACTION: keep the open 78k REACH daily_thesis position; it is weaker now, but there is still no valid management trigger and no clean second daily setup.
decision.rationale: Active strategy is beecthor. Reconciliation is clean, daily_success_cooldown is inactive, and the only open BTC price-hit position remains will-bitcoin-reach-78k-on-may-20 Yes in the daily_thesis slot. The latest Beecthor thesis is still stale and broadly bearish, but the existing trade was based on his explicitly mapped 78k rebound area plus earlier Binance confirmation. At 14:00 UTC the position has weakened, with current value around 0.7363 and market probability around 0.405, yet there is still no valid REDUCE or CLOSE trigger: the live executable sell price is only about 0.40 best bid, far below the 0.75 partial-take-profit threshold and nowhere near the 0.90-0.95 full take-profit zone. A losing exit is not allowed because stop-loss sales are disabled. Binance still prints bullish_short_term with positive 12h/24h/48h changes, but the structure is less convincing than at entry because spot is back near 77209, below the 24h high, and open interest is contracting. That is enough to avoid adding, not enough to justify a forced exit. A second daily is also not clean: 76k DIP Yes around 0.27 conflicts with the still-bullish intraday bias and lacks a clean breakdown, while 79k REACH Yes around 0.08 would require a fresh extension after upside momentum already cooled. The correct action is to hold.
